heroHeadline: 15 Days to Kickoff — USMNT Squad Official, Iran Moves to Tijuana, Netherlands & South Africa Squads Confirmed
heroSubtitle: Mauricio Pochettino announced the official USMNT 26-man World Cup roster at The Rooftop at Pier 17 in New York City on May 26 (live on FOX) — Christian Pulisic captains, Gio Reyna returns, Alejandro Zendejas (Club América) is the headline surprise, and Diego Luna and Tanner Tessmann were among the notable snubs. The squad's average age of 26 years 332 days makes it the fifth youngest USMNT World Cup side in modern history. Iran's visa crisis reached a definitive resolution on May 26 as the football federation confirmed its base camp has been moved from Tucson, Arizona to Tijuana, Mexico — an unprecedented logistical arrangement in World Cup history. Iran will commute across the US-Mexico border for each of their three group-stage matches after the US government failed to issue any visas to the Iranian delegation. Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum confirmed Mexico has 'no issue' hosting Iran's team. Spain made history on May 25 when Luis de la Fuente named a 26-man squad with zero Real Madrid players — the first time in World Cup history — with eight Barcelona stars, a fit Lamine Yamal, and the return of Gavi. On May 27, Ronald Koeman announced the Netherlands' squad featuring Memphis Depay's return from injury (Xavi Simons out with ACL), while South Africa confirmed their Bafana Bafana squad at a presidential event in Pretoria — they open the tournament vs Mexico at Estadio Azteca on June 11. Lionel Messi suffered a hamstring scare on May 24 (Inter Miami vs Philadelphia Union), though it was confirmed as 'muscular overload not a tear' — Argentina's final 26-man squad is due May 30. FIFA has confirmed Madonna, Shakira, and BTS will co-headline the World Cup Final halftime show on July 19, drawing criticism from football traditionalists. Champions League Final (PSG vs Arsenal, May 31) will release Achraf Hakimi to Morocco immediately after. Final rosters due June 1; FIFA publishes all 48 squads June 2.
